ShortDescription.Value: [WIP / EXPERIMENTAL] Placeable animated LED screens and billboards that play your own GIFs, images and videos. Back up your saves!

Publish.LongDescription:
## ⚠️ Work in progress: use at your own risk
This mod is an early, **experimental** release. Before using it:
- **Back up your save games.** Keep a copy of any city you place LED screens in. - **Removing the mod later** will remove its screens from saves that contain them. - Updates may still change things, and bugs are possible.
Please report problems on GitHub (link below) with a screenshot and your `Logs/LedScreens.Mod.log`.
---
## What it does
Adds placeable **animated LED screens and digital billboards**. Every screen plays your own media, and each one can show something different.
- **About 40 screens, each with its own icon:** wall screens, posters, ticker strips, **video walls and building facades** (up to about 50 × 20 m), free-standing billboards, street totems, roadside screens, **high-pole screens** (up to *Mega* and *Ribbon*, plus portrait and **double-sided** versions) and round signs - **Media:** animated **GIF**, **PNG/JPG** images and **videos** (MP4, WebM, MOV and more) - **Per-screen controls** in the info panel: media, speed, brightness, sync / random start - **Playlists:** cycle through several files **in order** or **shuffled** - **Optional LED look:** *Pixelated* or *LED dots* effect - **Self-lit:** screens keep the same brightness day and night
## How to use
1. **Add your media:** Options → LED Screens → **Open media folder**, then drop in your `.gif`, `.png`, `.jpg` or video files and press **Reload media**. 2. **Place a screen:** in your city, open **Landscaping → LED Screens** and place one. 3. **Pick what it shows:** **click the screen**. Its info panel has an **LED Screen** section where you choose the media or set up a playlist.
Tip: for smooth video playback, use MP4 (H.264 baseline). See the full guide on GitHub.
## Open source
Free and open source (MIT). Feel free to edit it, build it and contribute: https://github.com/or1995/led-billboards-cs2
